privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This site collects the minimum personal data needed to work. Below I explain what I collect, why, how I store it, and what rights you have over that information. If anything is unclear, email me at the contact address at the end of this page.
privacy.collect_body:
**Email:** when you submit a writer suggestion, and optionally to let you know when I publish your suggestion.

**Name (optional):** if you include it when submitting a suggestion, so I can credit you if I publish that writer.

**Transient technical data:** IP addresses and user-agents flow through my hosting providers' logs (Cloudflare, Supabase) for 24-72 hours to prevent abuse. I don't store them directly.
privacy.legal_basis_body: Processing is based on your **consent** (to let you know about your suggestion and to reply to you). You can withdraw consent at any time by contacting me — details below.
privacy.retention_body:
**Suggestions:** until I process them (publish the writer or reject the suggestion). After that I keep the record to avoid duplicate suggestions.

**Admin accounts:** only mine; the site doesn't allow public account registration.
privacy.thirdparties_body:
The site relies on these services as data processors:

**Supabase** (database, authentication) — region `eu-west-1` (Ireland), GDPR-compliant.

**Cloudflare** (web hosting, DNS, Turnstile bot defense) — global infrastructure; DPA signed.

**DeepL** (translation in the admin panel, used only by me) — EU-based, GDPR-compliant.

**Resend** (transactional email delivery) — DPA signed.
privacy.cookies_body: This site does not use tracking or analytics cookies. The only cookie set is the admin session cookie, and it's only created if you (Danny) log in at `/admin`. There is no cookie banner because there is nothing to consent to.
privacy.rights_body:
Under GDPR you have the right to:

- Access the data I hold about you
- Correct it if inaccurate
- Request deletion
- Data portability
- Object to processing
- Withdraw consent at any time

To exercise any of these rights, email the contact address below and I'll respond within 30 days.
privacy.contact_body: For any privacy question or to exercise your rights, email **hola@mapadeautoras.com**.
privacy.changes_body: If I update this policy, I'll change the date at the top of the page.
